prompt: Create an original 60 second Chinese chamber instrumental instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: guzheng, xiao, soft wooden percussion. Style: pentatonic melodic arcs, plucked ornament and spacious breath. Tempo approximately 62 BPM; D major. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A serene and traditional Chinese instrumental piece featuring a guzheng and a dizi, creating a calm and reflective atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首宁静而传统的中国器乐曲，以古筝和笛子为主，营造出平静而沉思的氛围。
